cited.quote: subsidy assistance of Rs.10,000/- will be extended for purchasing new electric motor pumpsets

rationale: C1 is a budget speech announcing the Rs.10,000 electric motor pumpset subsidy for farmers with under three acres; it is a statement of intent, not a GO. C2, C3 and C5 are RKVY GOs on other machinery/seed subsidies; C4 is an audit on tractors. No official step shown.

cited.quote: On a pilot basis, 30 mobile vegetable shops will be operated in five Corporations

rationale: C3 (budget speech) proposes mobile vegetable shops in corporations, a related plan, but no GO or permit scheme for mobile marketing is shown. C1 and C4 are an RKVY GO on godowns and processing units; C2 and C5 are unrelated. Not started.
No extract concerns building construction fees. C1 and C2 concern capitation/tuition fees of colleges, C3 and C5 are audit paras on other subjects, C4 is Namakku Naame Thittam guidelines.
None of C1-C5 mentions an Ariyalur-Thanjavur rail line; they cover metro rail, a cement plant in Ariyalur, flood restoration culverts and a Coimbatore MRTS DPR.

cited.quote: The lumpsum amount payable under Tamil Nadu Government Servants’ Family Security Fund Scheme shall be enhanced to Rs.5,00,000/-
The above Orders shall take effect from 01-09-2021.

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.197 dated 01.09.2021 enhancing the lumpsum paid on death of Government employees in service from Rs.3,00,000 to Rs.5,00,000; C3 shows it takes effect from 01-09-2021. Matches the promise amount.
No extract concerns a joint committee or the State Administrative Tribunal. C1 and C2 are Departmental Promotion Committee guidelines, C3 an RTI officers list, C4 and C5 a bus condemnation GO.

cited.quote: subsidy will be extended for the purchase of modern jaggery making machineries

rationale: C1 (budget speech) only announces training and subsidy for modern palm jaggery machinery. C3 and C4 are a GO permitting sale of palm jaggery through fair price shops, which is marketing, not production/processing technology. No official step on technology upgrade.

cited.quote: Function as leading institutions for consultation and guidance for addressing man-animal conflict issues.

rationale: Extracts concern human-wildlife conflict generally: rescue centres (C1), compensation (C3, C5), invasive species policy (C2), archives (C4). None identifies animal routes or protects people living along them. Related activity only.
No extract mentions free electricity for powerlooms. C1 and C5 concern solar dryers, C2-C4 general power sector information.

cited.quote: two flyrng squads shall be formed at Chennai and Salem Regions at a total cost of Rs. 1.22 crores

rationale: C4, G.O.(Ms) No.96 (2021-11-01), forms a Chennai flying squad to prevent sewage discharge and solid waste dumping into Adayar, Coovam and Buckingham canal. It addresses prevention of discharge but orders no removal of solid waste from waterways. C5 (water quality monitoring) and C2 (budget plans) add no further step.

cited.quote: The scheme to prevent outflow of sewage into waterways in Chennai will be vigorously implemented

rationale: C1 (budget speech) plans sewage outflow prevention for Chennai waterways, but no extract shows anti-mosquito or malodour measures along them. C4 and C5 concern water quality monitoring; C2 and C3 are unrelated.
No extract concerns shrimp farming. C1, C2 are an RKVY agriculture GO, C3 coconut nutrient management, C4 horticulture mission, C5 the agriculture budget speech.
No extract concerns coastal shrimp farms or their regulation; C1-C5 cover agriculture schemes, organic farming and agro-forestry.

No extract shows an order to revive welfare boards. C1 mentions a past Thirunangai Welfare Board, C5 a Waqf Board administrative grant, C3 a trust's trustees, C2 SADP agencies, C4 Governor's address on other topics.

No extract concerns meetings of welfare boards. C1, C2 are an inspection report of the Registrar of Cooperative Societies, C3 a bonded labour SOP mentioning registration in welfare boards, C4 an RTI list, C5 DPC meeting procedure.
No extract mentions sea erosion barriers or groynes. C1, C2 concern soil erosion structures in farms, C3 a climate company, C4 tourism, C5 fisheries harbours.

cited.quote: special camps would be organized in every village to redress the issues related to Patta

rationale: C1 and C3 (G.O.(Ms) No.644) set up village camps to correct patta errors in land records, and C5 extends house-site patta for poramboke encroachments. None concerns verifying occupancy and issuing patta for Grama Natham lands. Related activity only.
No extract concerns the Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit cash assistance. C1-C4 deal with maternity leave for women Government servants, C5 an agriculture GO.

cited.quote: The Government is actively working to enhance road safety measures and reduce the accidents involving State Transport Undertakings buses.

rationale: C1 and C4 discuss government bus accidents and road safety, and C2, C3 the employees' health insurance scheme, but no extract shows medical insurance extended to cover victims of government bus accidents.
No extract concerns breastfeeding stations in public places; C1-C4 are COVID-19 protocols and C5 water quality monitoring.
